description: RATE on Excel's own PMT bits: each m9-fin-irr-rate RATE(n,PMT(..),..) cell with the PMT replaced by a cell holding Excel's value of that PMT call (m9-fin-pmt), written as its 15-digit literal plus an exact multiple of a power of two, so the engine's PMT bits do not enter (T-2527). Column C names the source cell.
